transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what brought me in is that I've been having some trouble with my eating habits lately. 

After my evening class, I sometimes stop for food, and I just end up eating a whole lot. I'll get a full fast-food meal, then grab candy from the vending machine, and then I go home and eat even more snacks on top of that. It's... it's like I'm making up for the whole day all at once, and I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
When you eat this much, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah, I do. Once I start on those snacks, I keep telling myself to just close the bag and go to bed. But... my hands just keep reaching for more. I really can't stop until I feel embarrassed and just sick of myself.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount while feeling unable to stop happen?

I'd say for about the past three months, it happens... well, usually at least one night a week. It's pretty much always after my class. And... I should probably just be upfront about it. When I overeat like that, I end up making myself throw up afterward.
How much does your weight or body shape affect how you feel about yourself?

Well, it affects me quite a bit, honestly. Um, on days when my shirt feels tight around my middle, I just... I feel like I've failed. I try to be a careful, disciplined person, you know? But when I feel like I've put on weight or my shape isn't right, it just ruins my confidence. Even if the rest of my bookkeeping work is perfectly fine that day, I still feel like a failure because of how my body looks.
